answer_sentences.text: No. It would not be compliant to only mention the bank’s online schedule of penal charges in the sanction letter and loan documents.
answer_sentences.quote: Further, providing a reference to the schedule of penal charges displayed on the website of a UCB in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice.

answer_sentences.text: The directions require the quantum and reason for penal charges to be clearly disclosed upfront in the loan agreement and KFS, in addition to being displayed on the website.
answer_sentences.quote: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by a UCB to the customers upfront in the loan agreement and KFS as applicable, in addition to being displayed on the UCB’s website under Interest rates and Service Charges.
